text:
Priya Raman: quick sync — EdgeVault reached out about a pilot for a marketplace listing that bundles their HSM appliance + managed KMS bridge. They want SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning wired to our console, plus an option for customer-managed keys. Can security/eng/legal weigh in on scope and timing?

Lucas Chen: thanks. high-level security checklist: SAML metadata exchange, SCIM schema mapping (groups/roles), KMS key-wrap API + CMEK compatibility, HSM FIPS/firmware certs, export-control constraints. do they provide a test HSM?

Jon Patel: vendor said they can provide a cloud sandbox (HSM emulator) and a short-term hardware loaner for staging. we need a reproducible test harness and CI smoke tests. @Nikhil Rao can you prototype scim + saml flows?

Nikhil Rao: yep — i'll spin up the sandbox tomorrow. sample SCIM PATCH i'll use for group mapping below:

```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "add",
      "path": "groups",
      "value": [
        {"display": "redwood-ops", "members": [{"value": "u-12345"}]}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Maya Ortiz: timeline check — partner wants a soft launch in 4 weeks and an embargo window 48h before public announcement. product needs to validate console UX, marketplace tile, and support docs. partnerships, can you draft the listing stub + screenshots placeholder?

Alice Nguyen: legal heads-up: HSM firmware may trigger export controls depending on destination. need NDA scope for press, clarify warranty/shipment terms for loaner hardware, and confirm PO/contract terms for reserved capacity. i'll start the NDA redline.

Priya Raman: proposed internal milestones: wk1 legal/risk signoff + NDA, wk2 eng/security integration + smoke tests, wk3 marketplace tile + docs + partner review, wk4 invite-only pilot + metrics collection. sound reasonable?

Lucas Chen: add a fallback policy test: if HSM unavailable, auto-fallback to our software KMS with clear audit trail and crypto ops logging. require key-wrap KATs (known-answer tests) and attestation flow checks.

Jon Patel: also confirm telemetry hooks for per-request latency/cost and ensure log scrubbers for any PII in SCIM payloads. will carve out staging capacity.

Nikhil Rao: created a gist for a minimal smoke harness: https://gist.github.com/nikhil/edgevault-scim-smoke — i'll update after i run the first pass.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: EdgeVault pilot kickoff — Thu 10:00 PT (invite sent). :calendar:

Priya Raman: action items from here: @Lucas prepare security checklist doc, @Jon reserve staging slot and add CI job, @Alice start NDA redline, @Nikhil run initial SCIM/SAML smoke by Tue. i'll draft the pilot runbook and post it here.

Lucas Chen: :thumbsup: will share checklist by EOD today.

Maya Ortiz: i'll reserve the marketplace slot and draft a short listing copy template — need partner logo and 1-2 screenshots from them.

Nikhil Rao: got sandbox creds from partner, starting tests now. will ping here if anything blocks.

Priya Raman: :raised_hands: perfect — closing interim sync. i'll post the runbook link + a short public launch prep checklist once legal finishes NDA.
